subject: Nest Thermostat setup stuck at wiring check
body: Good afternoon. I am trying to install a Google Nest Learning Thermostat (3rd gen, model T3007ES) in my flat in Pune. The Home app gets to 'Checking wires' and then says 'We couldn't detect your wiring, error NT-4021' every time. I switched off the breaker before removing my old thermostat, and photographed the wires as advised, which are connected to Rh, W1, Y1 and G. I have tried pressing the wire connectors fully and re-seating the base plate twice. I also updated the Home app to version 3.21 and rebooted my phone. The display on the thermostat itself powers on and shows the setup code, so it is receiving power. The old thermostat was a basic Honeywell one and heating worked correctly with it. Could you tell me what else to try before I call an electrician? Kind regards, Rajesh Nair
